description: Hand-maintained annotations for the generated environment-variable reference. The generator extracts literal env reads from non-test first-party Rust/TypeScript and fails on any bidirectional mismatch with this list. Entries here may need reconciliation on the first generator run after a baseline advance.

variables.name: COGNITIVE_KERNEL_SERVER
variables.description_en: Overrides the kernel-server executable path used to spawn the daemon.
variables.description_zh: 覆盖用于启动 daemon 的 kernel-server 可执行文件路径。

variables.name: COGNITIVEOS_BENCHMARK_SAMPLES
variables.description_en: Sample count for the deterministic module benchmark (hypothesis-only output).
variables.description_zh: 确定性模块基准的采样数（输出仅为 hypothesis）。

variables.name: COGNITIVEOS_PI_ROUTE_OBSERVATION
variables.description_en: Set to enabled to request Pi route stage measurement on the Pi client and nested preflight/correlation echo on the daemon. Anything else, including absence, leaves both sides uninstrumented.
variables.description_zh: 设为 enabled 才请求 Pi 侧 route stage 测量以及 daemon 侧 nested preflight/correlation 回显；其他值（含缺省）两侧均不启用插桩。

variables.name: COGNITIVEOS_PI_ROUTE_OBSERVATION_CAMPAIGN
variables.description_en: Campaign identifier the measurement session is authorized for. Required alongside the enable variable; credential-shaped values are refused.
variables.description_zh: 该测量会话被授权的 campaign 标识；必须与启用变量同时提供，凭据形状的值一律拒绝。

variables.name: COGNITIVEOS_PI_ROUTE_OBSERVATION_SINK
variables.description_en: Optional absolute .ndjson path an embedding campaign harness may write. The Extension never opens it, and any path inside a Personal state, runtime or config root is refused.
variables.description_zh: 可选的绝对 .ndjson 路径，供嵌入的 campaign harness 写入；Extension 自身绝不打开它，且位于 Personal state/runtime/config 根内的路径一律拒绝。

variables.name: COGNITIVEOS_PI_TASK_REF
variables.description_en: Task-bound public Pi launch context. The Extension submits only untrusted Workspace candidate fields to the authenticated daemon Task channel for validation and admission.
variables.description_zh: public Pi 任务绑定启动上下文。Extension 仅将不可信 Workspace candidate 字段提交到已认证 daemon Task 通道，由 daemon 校验并接纳。

variables.name: COGNITIVEOS_PRIVATE_COMPLETION_SOCKET
variables.description_en: Path of the daemon-created one-shot private completion socket handed to the Pi candidate process.
variables.description_zh: daemon 创建并交给 Pi candidate 进程的一次性私有 completion socket 路径。

variables.name: DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS
variables.description_en: Signals a session bus for the Linux Secret Service backend probe.
variables.description_zh: 为 Linux Secret Service 后端探测提供会话总线信号。

variables.name: HOME
variables.description_en: Fallback base for the XDG roots when the specific variables are absent.
variables.description_zh: XDG 变量缺失时的回退基目录。

variables.name: P9_T01_RUNS
variables.description_en: Run count for the async-migration decision observation.
variables.description_zh: 异步迁移决策观测的运行次数。

variables.name: P9_T01_SAMPLES
variables.description_en: Per-run sample count for the async-migration decision observation.
variables.description_zh: 异步迁移决策观测的每轮采样数。

variables.name: USERPROFILE
variables.description_en: Windows stand-in for HOME when resolving the XDG-style layout.
variables.description_zh: Windows 上解析 XDG 式布局时替代 HOME。

variables.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
variables.description_en: Config root for non-secret provider/model/Pi configuration files.
variables.description_zh: 配置根目录，存放非 secret 的 provider/model/Pi 配置文件。

variables.name: XDG_DATA_HOME
variables.description_en: Data root; also hosts the product deployment root for the Linux bundle installer.
variables.description_zh: 数据根目录；也是 Linux bundle 安装器的产品部署根。

variables.name: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR
variables.description_en: Runtime root; hosts the bootstrap secret and daemon lock. No fallback: absence fails closed.
variables.description_zh: 运行时根目录；存放 bootstrap secret 与 daemon lock。无回退：缺失即 fail closed。

variables.name: XDG_STATE_HOME
variables.description_en: State root for databases, backups, and the published daemon endpoint document.
variables.description_zh: 状态根目录，存放数据库、备份与已发布的 daemon endpoint 文档。
